alex.t: Heads up — PR #6823 (migration guide + SDK example) is ready for final review but blocked on a runtime clarification.
maria.docs: Which clarification? I thought kevin already looked at the API semantics.
alex.t: Reviewer flagged the SDK snippet showing streaming and wants a canonical example for migration. Also docs preview failed the linkcheck unrelated to this but we need to re-run before merging.
maria.docs: Can someone from runtime confirm the default behavior: if a user calls the SDK example without `stream=true` do we still send SSEs or is the default buffered? I want the guide to be prescriptive.
kevin-runtime: @maria.docs @alex.t quick answer: default is buffered (no SSE) unless `stream: true` is set. We added an opt-in flag in runtime v0.9.2. If you include `response_mode: "streaming"` it's equivalent to `stream: true` for the SDK wrapper.
olivia-se: Thanks — we should show both variants in the migration section: legacy buffered call and new streaming call. Reviewer was also worried about how `max_tokens` interacts with streaming.
kevin-runtime: For streaming we start sending tokens as they generate; `max_tokens` still applies to stopping condition, nothing special. Edge case: if you use prefix caching + streaming there's a minor race we fixed in v0.9.2; without that patch you might see truncated final tokens. Recommend calling out the minimum runtime version: >= 0.9.2 in the migration guide.
alex.t: Perfect. I'll add a short note and a tiny snippet. Proposed SDK snippet:

```
# python pseudocode
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
# buffered (default)
resp = client.generate("Summarize this...")
print(resp.text)

# streaming (opt-in)
for chunk in client.generate("Summarize this...", stream=True):
    process(chunk)
```

maria.docs: That looks good. Add a one-liner about runtime >= 0.9.2 and the prefix-caching race fix.
ryan-sre: CI: docs-preview build failed: linkcheck error in migration guide (404 on internal model-id link). Re-running after the snippet change might pass.
ci-bot: docs-preview re-run queued by olivia-se — build id 11892. Status will post here.
olivia-se: I'll fix the broken internal link to the model ID and push a small commit now.
kevin-runtime: One more tiny nit: in the streaming snippet use `stream=True` in the example for Python style consistency (capitalization) and call out JSONL vs SSE as an aside.
maria.docs: Ok I'll make the edits and request final review from @kevin-runtime and @olivia-se. If CI passes and you both approve, I'll merge.
alex.t: Thanks all. Tagging the release note: "migration: clarify streaming opt-in and minimum runtime version" :thumbsup:
ci-bot: docs-preview success (build id 11892) — linkcheck fixed.
